{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_05","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools.","storage_note":"Pandas materializes recorded_at as SQLite YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS timestamps. Compare timestamps semantically, for example datetime(recorded_at)<=datetime(cutoff). Raw lexical comparison with a T-separated cutoff changes same-day ordering."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_05 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-05","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table. ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), invoices AS (SELECT * FROM latest WHERE kind='invoice' AND status='active' AND vendor='BLUE' AND date(due_date) <= date('2026-10-30')), payments AS (SELECT kind='credit' AND status='active' GROUP BY invoice_id), holds AS (SELECT invoice_id,SUM(amount_minor) AS amount FROM latest WHERE kind='hold' AND status NOT IN ('release','void') GROUP BY invoice_id), invoice_values AS (SELECT i.*, MAX(0,i.amount_minor-COALESCE(p.amount,0)-COALESCE(c.amount,0)) AS remaining, COALESCE(h.amount,0) AS held FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.event_key LEFT JOIN credits c ON c.invoice_id=i.event_key LEFT JOIN holds h ON h.invoice_id=i.event_key), adjusted AS (SELECT v.*, MAX(0,v.remaining-v.held) AS unheld, t.discount_bps, CASE WHEN date('2026-10-23') <= date(v.discount_until) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS discount_applies, f.fx_num, f.fx_den FROM invoice_values v JOIN latest t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.status='active' AND t.event_key=v.terms_code AND date(t.business_date) <= date(v.business_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest t2 WHERE t2.kind='terms' AND t2.status='active' AND t2.event_key=v.terms_code AND date(t2.business_date) <= date(v.business_date) AND date(t2.business_date)>date(t.business_date)) JOIN latest f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.status='active' AND f.event_key=v.currency AND date(f.business_date) <= date(v.business_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest f2 WHERE f2.kind='fx' AND f2.status='active' AND f2.event_key=v.currency AND date(f2.business_date) <= date(v.business_date) AND date(f2.business_date)>date(f.business_date))), rounded AS (SELECT *, CAST((2 * unheld * CASE WHEN discount_applies=1 THEN (10000-discount_bps) ELSE 10000 END * fx_num + 10000 * fx_den) / (2 * 10000 * fx_den) AS INTEGER) AS usd_cents FROM adjusted) SELECT SUM(usd_cents) AS total_usd_cents FROM rounded WHERE unheld >= 0"}}
